about: The Node.js that runs server.mjs in the browser package: the latest LTS release on 2026-10-23 (Node 24 supports Windows 10 and macOS 13.5 or later). The SHA-256 sums are those of the release's SHASUMS256.txt, whose GPG signature was checked against nodejs/release-keys when they were pinned. tools/distribution/pack_browser.mjs downloads each file into .cache/node-runtime/ and refuses one whose sum differs.
